cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through it using your own information and channels.

seo.title: AI chatbot for hotels and travel businesses | Steps AI
seo.description: Answer guest and traveller questions, capture booking enquiries and hand over to your team on WhatsApp, Instagram and your website.

hero.title: Answer guests before they book somewhere else.
hero.body: Travellers ask about rooms, packages, timings and policies at all hours. Your agent answers from your information, captures enquiries and passes bookings to your team.
hero.reassurance: Answers any time. Enquiries saved. Your team confirms the booking.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: Steps AI does not connect to hotel booking engines. Your team confirms availability and bookings.

items.q: Can the agent confirm a room booking?
items.a: It collects the enquiry and passes it to your team, who confirm availability.
